name: Sum-of-the-Parts
summary: Sum-of-the-parts build-up: each segment's metric × multiple range stacked into an EV range, then net debt and other deductions down to the implied equity value and value per share.
summary_zh: 分部加总估值累加图：各业务板块“指标 × 倍数区间”逐段累加成企业价值区间，再扣除净负债等调整项得到隐含股权价值与每股价值区间。
description_zh: 投行分部估值（SOTP）页的核心图表。数据每行一个业务板块（segment、metric_name、metric_value、multiple_low、multiple_high、method），每段横条在低倍数累计值上浮动：实色 = 按低倍数计算的价值贡献，浅色延伸 = 按高倍数多出的价值；公司总部费用等负值行与净负债、养老金、少数股东权益等扣减项依次向左回走，最后得到股权价值区间。左侧第二行文字给出“指标 × 倍数”的计算依据，右侧一列为每股价值，虚线参考线标出当前股价（股价 × 稀释股数，与图表同一 USD m 刻度）。适用于多元化集团、分拆 / 剥离分析与“集团折价”论证；净负债、股数等数值选项可绑定 @参数，随假设滑块实时重算。
best_for: Break-up and spin-off analysis (hidden value vs. market cap)
Showing which segment drives value and the metric × multiple behind it
avoid_when: Segments valued on incompatible bases that cannot sum to one EV

metric.desc: Valuation metric (EBITDA, revenue …, USD m); a negative value (unallocated corporate costs) walks down

metricName.desc: Metric name shown in the basis line and tooltip (e.g. 'EBITDA 2026E')

method.desc: Valuation method shown in the tooltip footer (e.g. 'EV / EBITDA 2026E')

note.desc: Basis / peer reference shown in the tooltip footer

netDebt.desc: Net debt deducted from the EV build (USD m), or an '@param' name

netDebtLabel.desc: Label of the net debt row

netDebtNote.desc: Second line under the net debt label (e.g. 'As of 30-Sep-2026')

deductions.desc: [{label, value, note}] further EV -> equity items (pension, minorities, associates); a positive value is deducted, a negative value added; value may be an '@param'

shares.desc: Diluted shares (m) or an '@param' — enables the per-share column and the reference lines

refPrice.desc: Current share price (or '@param'): dashed reference line at price × shares in the theme reference colour

refLabel.desc: Caption prefix of the reference line (default 'Current', followed by the price)

refLines.desc: [{price, label, color}] further per-share reference lines, e.g. the offer price with color 'accent2'

evMetric.desc: {label, value} — implied multiple shown under the EV total (e.g. {"label": "EV / EBITDA 2026E", "value": 996.5})

evLabel.desc: Label of the EV total row

equityLabel.desc: Label of the equity total row

equityNote.desc: Second line under the equity total (default: diluted share count, e.g. '158.0m diluted shares')

lowLabel.desc: Legend text of the solid part of each bar

highLabel.desc: Legend text of the light extension

showBasis.desc: Metric × multiple line under each segment name (implied multiple under the EV total)

multipleFormat.desc: Multiple format; defaults to the low field's format ('0.0x')

metricFormat.desc: Metric format; defaults to the metric field's format

labels.desc: Low – high value labels at the bar ends

connectors.desc: Dashed connectors along the low-case running total

valueAxis.desc: Show a value axis with light gridlines (the labels carry the numbers by default)

legend.desc: Key for the solid / light bar parts, top-left

paramDefaults.desc: Fallback values for '@param' options the report does not define (they are then defined in the store, shared with sliders)

crossFilter.desc: Click a segment to cross-filter other blocks (segment names match segment_revenue / segments_tree)

interactions: Hover tooltip with the metric × multiple math, share of EV and value per share
Click a segment to cross-filter (others dim)
Live recompute when bound @params change (net debt, shares, price)
Animated transitions on filter / parameter updates
Re-lays out on resize (label columns, value-label room)

samples.title: Sorted build-up with offer line and value axis (net debt bound to @net_debt)
